Survey written at `library/domains/science/domains/medicine/domains/medical-technology/domains/air-purification/texts/mid-range-hepa-purifier-comparison.md`.

Covers five models across four performance tiers:
- **Winix 5500-2 & Coway AP-1512HH** (~240 CFM) — the real mid-range workhorses at $130-200
- **Honeywell HPA200** (~190 CFM) — awkward middle ground
- **Levoit Core 300S-P** (~140 CFM) — best value for bedrooms, only one with app/PM2.5 readout
- **Blueair Blue Pure 411** (~70 CFM) — too small for the target room size

All CADR figures are AHAM Verifide. The survey flags that no manufacturer in this class provides third-party filter media verification (H13 claims are unverified), carbon mass, pressure drop curves, or sensor accuracy specs. It cross-references the existing Levoit compact survey for standards background.

tool_input.prompt: Extract specifications: HEPA type, filtration stages, CADR ratings, noise levels at different speeds, power consumption, filter cost and replacement schedule, smart features, certifications, price
